name: Repro: downsample basic 1Min to 1D
description: Tests whether downsample(1D) works at all on 1Min data. Control: close price. Test: session_window range.
source:
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# CONTROL: downsample close price (dense, 83k non-null values)
daily_close = resample(close, target_timeframe=1D, agg=["Last"])

# TEST 1: downsample high-low range (dense, no session_window)
intraday_range = high - low
daily_range = resample(intraday_range, target_timeframe=1D, agg=["Max"])

# TEST 2: session_window then downsample
rth_sw = session_window(session=SessionType.EquityRTHSession)(src.o, high, low, close)
session_range = rth_sw.high - rth_sw.low
daily_session_range = resample(session_range, target_timeframe=1D, agg=["Max"])

# TEST 3: where(closed) path
daily_where = where(rth_sw.closed, session_range)

xy_lines(
    title='All Paths',
    category='Comparison',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Control: Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Test1: Range', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Test2: Session Range', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Test3: Where', color=Color.Gray)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(daily_close, daily_range, daily_session_range, daily_where))
